steps.body: Three addends join two at a time: pick a pair, add it, then let the last addend join the running total.
steps.narration: Three addends join two at a time: pick a pair, add it, then let the last addend join the running total.

widget.prompt: Show 24 + 13 + 10 in stages: from 37, one ten-hop for the last addend.

commonLandings.feedback: That hop added one — the last addend here is a whole ten.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop adds 10. From 37, 1 hops land on 47.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 47 — the pair banked 37, and the last addend hopped it home.

predict.prompt: 24 + 13 + 10: can you add just two of them first?

options.label: Yes — pair, then join the third

predict.reveal: Addition happily goes two at a time: 24 + 13 = 37, then 37 + 10 = 47.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2n three addends.
invariants: Regrouping addends changes the ORDER of joining, never the total — every staging of the sum must land on the same number for g2n three addends.
misconceptions: Believing the grouping or order of addends can change a sum, or letting an addend join twice or not at all while restaging.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which single change to the staging would actually change the total — and which only changes the path?

explanationVariants: The first pair opens the sum.

commonErrors.feedback: That is the WHOLE sum — this stage joins only the first pair.
The pair is the first two addends; 13 waits for the next stage.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Stage the sum: pick a pair, bank the total, and let each remaining addend join one at a time.

widget.prompt: You add 17 + 25 + 3 as (17 + 3) + 25. Is the total allowed to change?

options.label: No — regrouping addends never changes a sum
options.feedback: Correct — addition lets you group in any order; 20 + 25 and the left-to-right path both reach 45.

options.label: Yes — the parentheses add extra
options.feedback: Parentheses only choose which pair goes first; they contribute nothing of their own.

options.label: Only if the answer stays under 20
options.feedback: The regrouping freedom has no size limit — it is a property of addition itself.

options.label: Yes — 3 must always join last
options.feedback: That treats position as a rule, but addends own no fixed turn — 17 + 3 first is exactly the friendly-pair move.
